title: Tarrot Reading Room
tagline: Discover the secrets of your future!
description:
Enter the Tarrot Reading Room, where you can explore the mysteries of the tarot. Watch as your cards reveal insights, guidance, and hidden truths.

Features:
- Draw your cards: Select cards from the deck and uncover their meanings.
- Interpret the symbols: Learn about the symbolism and significance of each card.
- Gain insights: Receive guidance and reflections based on your card readings.
